comment: The words people never read on a Rasputin page: engine names and authenticator brands (ui.md §4.4; principles.md:78-90 and :100-105). One list, read by every scan: the sign-in theme's (ui/identity-theme/test), the console source scan (ui/test/forbidden-words-console.test.ts), the DOM test hook (ui/test/dom.ts) and the CI walk (api/internal/identitytest). Matching is case-insensitive from a word start, with a multi-word entry matched across any white space (lib/forbidden-words.ts). An exemption is one exact string in one file, with its reason; it covers nothing else.

exemptions.reason: The private-network app's install command, which a person copies and pastes verbatim; Bryce's ruling D23 (2026-11-02) makes the app's store name and install command the second exception to the vendor-neutral copy rule.
